title: the coverage ratchet red while every test passed

findings.claim: two tests in tests/unit/test_test_shard.py started pytest in trialbox/ with CI's PYTEST_ADDOPTS (--cov); pytest-cov then combined and deleted the coverage files that finished xdist workers had saved there, so shard 3 lost one worker's lines (18,738 in run 44628868228) while every test passed, and the ratchet reported a false fall on the required check unit
findings.severity_basis: a person misled: a required check red on a change that touches no service code, cleared only by a rerun
findings.fix: the nested runs drop PYTEST_ADDOPTS; tools/coverage_shards.py refuses a nested pytest that measures coverage in the outer run's folder; tests/unit/test_coverage_shards_h63.py
findings.from: unit job 135944262250 of run 44628868228 against unit job 135898844783 of run 44614992770, shard 3's coverage.db compared; the integrator's report of train 100

findings.claim: an xdist worker that returns no coverage data, or a shard whose coverage.db never reaches the unit job, lost its lines without a failing step: pytest-cov names such a worker only in the report CI turns off, and the combine reads a glob
findings.severity_basis: the same false fall could come by another way; not seen in the runs read
findings.fix: tools/coverage_shards.py: the controller fails the run and names the worker; unit's step 'Every shard's coverage data is present' names a missing shard before the combine
findings.from: pytest-cov 7.1.0 engine.DistMaster.testnodedown and summary; a pytest -n 2 --cov run whose worker exits after its last test, green before the fix
